interface.longDescription: Create and restyle illustrations in Mid-century Ink, 1950s Cartoon Modernism, in two treatments: Original / Classic graphic and Detailed storybook. Keeps a whole cast consistent and protects approved character identities. Also builds native SVGs and animation-ready rigged characters in 3D, with walks, gaits, scenes, ropes and slim rigs.
defaultPrompt: Use Mid-century Ink to illustrate my prompt or restyle my photo.
